chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ziyad ibn Marwan, who said:
A plague struck the people in Makkah, so I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), and he wrote to me: 'Eat the apple'.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) recommend for plague prevention?
ai.summary: Ziyad ibn Marwan reports that during a plague in Makkah, he wrote to Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) for guidance. The Imam replied with a simple instruction to eat apples, indicating their medicinal or preventive properties against the disease.
